text: With scope locked, this is the first real architecture decision: exactly what tools build and run the weekly churn-risk score.
The constraints are real: a weekly cadence, not real-time; entirely tabular data; and a firm commitment to explain every flag, not just produce a number.

The fixed stack: T-SQL extraction from EVERPEAK_PROD, pandas for wrangling, a scikit-learn Logistic Regression baseline, LightGBM as the production model, SHAP for explanations, and a weekly Azure ML Batch Endpoint writing to dbo.ChurnRiskScores.
A real-time endpoint, deep learning, and Logistic Regression alone were all considered and rejected on purpose, not by default, each one against this project's real constraints.
Next: planning the T-SQL extraction that turns EVERPEAK_PROD into a modeling-ready table.
